description: Presidetial Secretariat - Order to removed Hon. W. Rajapakshe from the office of the Minister of Justice, w.e.f. 23.08.2017
categorisation: This gazette content specifically names an individual (Honourable Wijeyadasa Rajapakshe) and announces his removal from a government office (Minister of Justice).
